image_alt: A whippet walks along a wide gravel woodland track lined with golden bracken and autumn trees.

text.facebook: Chocolate and sweets containing xylitol are both dangerous to dogs, the vet charity PDSA warned this week ahead of Halloween. With the clocks gone back, it's dark on the Forest by teatime too. My tip: walk your dog in daylight, well before trick-or-treaters start knocking, and keep the sweet bowl out of reach. 🎃 https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/halloween-and-dogs
